compute_accuracy: compute top-1, top-5, and recall@5 accuracy metrics from model predictions and ground truth labels
read_results: read model prediction results from .pth or .h5 result files in a given output directory
get_epic_marginalize_late_fuse: late fuse predictions from multiple model runs with configurable weights for verb, noun, and action scores
package_results_for_submission: package fused prediction results into seen.json and unseen.json files and zip them for challenge submission
plot_per_cls_perf: plot per-class recall@5 bar charts comparing multiple model runs across verb and noun classes
